questions.question: What is the output of the following program code segment when a = -1 and b = 2? (FBISE 2022) if (++a == 0) printf ("%d", a + b); else printf("%d", b - a);
questions.explanation: Given a = -1 and b = 2: ++a pre-increments a to 0. The condition (++a == 0) evaluates to true (0 == 0). The if-branch executes: printf("%d", a + b) which evaluates to 0 + 2 = 2.
